title: Dreams
shortDescription: Revolutionary digital art studio allowing players to sculpt 3D models, compose music, and program entire games with a DualShock.
historicalSignificance: An unprecedented milestone in democratized game creation, empowering a vibrant global creative community.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
